lines.label: laneway excess over the flat circulation allowance
lines.basis: citybudget allows a flat 7% of interior for circulation and this map draws more: its ring, street and roji BEDS measure 57,712 px^2 against the 41,172 allowed. Measured, not estimated, and the same line Minami carries for the same reason. It is charged because without it the ring cannot seat the declared 600 dwellings - the population check allows NO band any more (GM 2026-07-26), and the answer to a map that cannot hold its declared figure is a wall sized to hold it, never a smaller figure. Tango shows a 10,284 px^2 excess by the same measurement and is NOT charged, because it meets its 600 without the room; if it ever falls short, this is the line
